class.name: PckPackageServer
class.brief_description: Reads, edits, builds, extracts, mounts and unmounts [code].pck[/code] files.

method.name: build
method.description: Writes [param package] as a new pack to [param target_path], using [PCKPacker]. The pack uses the current format, [member PckPackage.alignment] and [member PckPackage.encrypted_directory]. Encrypted entries stay encrypted and are encrypted again with [param key]; an empty [param key] uses the key of the package (see [method PckPackage.set_key]), or the key compiled into the engine. [code]ResourceSaver.save(package, "user://x.pck")[/code] calls this method with an empty [param key]. Building onto the pack the package was read from, or onto its [member PckPackage.base_pack], is allowed: the new pack is written to a temporary file first, then replaces the old one. A package that was read from that pack is read again from the new file. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] if [param target_path] is mounted (unmount it first), [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] if source files added with [method PckPackage.add_file] are missing (all of them are listed in the error, and nothing is written), and [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if the package has delta patches, which can't be rebuilt.

method.name: extract
get_mounted
method.description: Returns the paths of all mounted packs in mount order: the main pack of the project (also when it is embedded in the executable, or the sparse pack [code]res://assets.sparsepck[/code] on Android), packs mounted with [method mount] and packs loaded with [method ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack]. The project folder used by the editor is not a pack and is not listed.

method.name: get_pack_of
method.description: Returns the path of the mounted pack that provides [param res_path], as given to [method mount]. If several packs provide the same path, it is the pack whose file is used. Returns an empty [String] if the file does not come from a pack, for example project files in the editor or files inside an Android APK.

method.name: is_main_pack
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param path] is mounted as the main pack of the project. Main packs can't be unmounted.

method.name: is_mounted
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the pack [param path] is mounted.

method.name: mount
method.description: Mounts the [code].pck[/code] or [code].zip[/code] file [param path] into [code]res://[/code] and emits [signal pack_mounted]. If [param replace_files] is [code]true[/code], files of this pack replace files with the same path from earlier packs. [param offset] is the position of the pack inside the file (only for [code].pck[/code] files). This is the same as [method ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack], which calls this method. Returns [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] if the file does not exist and [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] if it is not a pack this engine can mount (for example a pack of a newer engine version). These errors are not printed, so that games can probe for optional packs. Returns [constant ERR_CYCLIC_LINK] and prints an error if [param replace_files] is [code]true[/code] and [param path] is a [code]res://[/code] path that the pack itself contains: the pack would replace itself, and every later open of the pack would read from it again. [b]Note:[/b] Encrypted packs are mounted with the script encryption key compiled into the engine.

method.name: open
method.description: Reads the header and the file list of the pack [param path] and returns them as a [PckPackage]. The pack is not mounted and no file data is read. [param key] decrypts an encrypted file list and encrypted files. [param offset] is the position of the pack inside the file; with [code]0[/code], a pack appended to the end of the file (a self-contained executable) is found as well. Pack format versions 2 to 4 are read, also from packs written by a newer engine version. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the file can't be read, is not a pack, or the key is wrong.

method.name: read_file
method.description: Returns the data of the file [param path] in [param package], decrypted with the key the package was opened with. For files added in memory, returns their pending data. Returns an empty array and prints an error if the file is missing, is a removal entry, or can't be decrypted (wrong key).

method.name: unmount
method.description: Unmounts the pack [param path] and emits [signal pack_unmounted]. Its files disappear from [code]res://[/code]; files of earlier packs that it replaced are available again, and files it removed come back. The file list is rebuilt from the remaining packs in their mount order, so unmounting takes as long as reading the file lists of all remaining packs. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if the pack is not mounted and [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] for the main pack of the project or if called from another thread than the main thread. [b]Note:[/b] Resources that were already loaded from the pack stay valid in memory and in the resource cache; they are not freed. Files that are open stay readable. Don't unmount a pack while a threaded load (see [method ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request]) reads from it.

method.name: verify
method.description: Reads every file of [param package] from its pack and compares it with the MD5 sum stored in the pack. Returns [constant OK] if all files match, [constant ERR_FILE_CORRUPT] for the first file that does not match, or the error of a file that can't be read. Removal entries, delta patches and files added in memory are skipped.

signal.name: extract_progress
signal.description: Emitted by [method extract] after each selected file of the pack, whether it was written or not. [param path] is the path of the file in the pack ([code]res://…[/code]), [param done] the number of files handled so far and [param total] the number of selected files. Emitted on the main thread: when [method extract] runs on another thread, the signal is deferred.

signal.name: pack_mounted
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread after the pack [param path] was mounted with [method mount] or [method ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack].

signal.name: pack_unmounted
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread after the pack [param path] was unmounted with [method unmount].

constants.constant: [method extract] leaves files that already exist in the target folder unchanged and lists them in [member PckExtractResult.skipped].
[method extract] overwrites files that already exist in the target folder.
[method extract] writes files that already exist in the target folder under a free name ([code]a_2.txt[/code], [code]a_3.txt[/code], …) and lists them in [member PckExtractResult.renamed].
